# PatchLabs

> PatchLabs finds personal-data leaks in apps built with AI (Lovable, Supabase, Bolt, Replit, Cursor-exported code). It rebuilds the app's database from the repo's own `supabase/migrations` in a disposable lab, tests what an anonymous visitor, a signed-in stranger and the owner can read, writes a fix (a SQL migration) and proves it in the lab before anyone ships it. It also scans the code and full git history for exposed AI, payment and database keys. It never connects to the customer's live app or database. The owner's engineer approves every change. Free for one app.

Key facts:
- Input: a public GitHub repo (private repos need a GitHub App, which is coming). Ownership is proven by committing `patchlabs-verify.txt` with a one-time code.
- Output: a report, a downloadable migration plus a one-click "commit this file on GitHub" link (automatic pull requests are coming), and an Ed25519-signed receipt.
- Lab study (PatchLabs, Nov 2026): 318 public Lovable/Supabase repos rebuilt; 106 of 318 (33%) let the wrong people read personal data; about 1 in 4 (25-28%) after removing businesses' own public contact details. Autonomous fixes: 18 of 20 passed the strict lab proof with no human (n=20, 9 Nov 2026); median $0.46 model cost and 3.5 minutes per app.
- Plans: Free £0 (1 app), Maker £19/month (3 apps), Agency £99/month (10 apps, +£8 per extra app), Enterprise custom. Card payments are not live; paid plans are by request.
- API: https://api.patchlabs.dev (REST, JSON). Remote MCP server: POST https://api.patchlabs.dev/mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0; tools rls_check, start_check, get_check, list_apps, run_check).
- Contact: manraj@patchlabs.dev (security reports: same address, subject "Security"). Founder: Manraj Singh Dhillon, London.
- Independent: not affiliated with Lovable, Supabase, Bolt, Replit or Cursor.

## Product
- [Leak lab](https://patchlabs.dev/product/leak-lab): who can read your Supabase data, tested and fixed
- [Key scan](https://patchlabs.dev/product/key-scan): exposed keys in code and full git history
- [Monitoring](https://patchlabs.dev/product/monitoring): scheduled re-checks and alerts on new leaks
- [Badge and proof page](https://patchlabs.dev/product/badge): a dated public record of the last check
- [Agencies](https://patchlabs.dev/agencies): keep client apps checked after handover
- [Lovable apps](https://patchlabs.dev/for/lovable)
